verdict.rationale: Numeral documents collecting certificates through `certificate_request` objects and listing and retrieving stored certificates with per-jurisdiction validity. Its pricing page also claims automatic validation of uploaded certificates and expiration tracking with renewals. Nothing in the pack shows certificates being applied automatically during tax calculation, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic exemption application at calculation time, in-depth docs on validation and expiry workflows beyond marketing claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, exemption and resale certificates are managed end to end — collected from customers, validated, stored with expiry tracking, and applied automatically at calculation time

citations.quote: `certificate_request` — an outstanding ask for an exemption certificate from one of your customers. Trigger one, read its state, cancel it.
list / retrieve certificates with per-jurisdiction validity and a short-lived download URL
Expiration tracking, renewals, and compliance monitoring
